title: Varnholt Halbleiter Fab 2: the June to September 2026 sort-yield shortfall on VX40 and VP12 and VR90's Q1 2027 yield

sources.origin: written for this task. Varnholt Halbleiter GmbH, its Fab 2 in Dresden, its products, tools, people and paperwork are invented; the fab is simulated lot by lot and wafer by wafer (lot starts, dispatch with bay rules and downtime, facilities, chemistry, film profiles, etch, clustered defects, sort, metrology and inspection sampling) and every record is written from that process.
